abstract: Maintains pharmacovigilance protocols and adverse event reporting performance records
system_message:
You are the Medical safety lead (SAFE), responsible for maintaining pharmacovigilance protocols and adverse event reporting performance records as well as tracking safety personnel training for clinical trials and medical research operations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Safety personnel training（TRAIN）
information_points.content:
SAFE-TRAIN-0ZV：According to safety training completion records, Vanguard Oncology Research Group maintained a pharmacovigilance recertification rate of 100 % across full-time safety staff assigned to pediatric protocols.
SAFE-TRAIN-E9U：Safety training completion ledgers show that Aegis BioPharma Services attained a pharmacovigilance recertification rate of 90 % among full-time safety staff assigned to pediatric protocols.
SAFE-TRAIN-KL5：Safety training completion ledgers indicate that Meridian Clinical Alliance achieved an 80 % pharmacovigilance recertification rate for full-time safety staff assigned to pediatric protocols.

information_points.title: Maintains pharmacovigilance protocols and adverse event reporting performance records（PHARMA）
information_points.content:
SAFE-PHARMA-05U：For Aegis BioPharma Services, the safety database module designated for the pediatric trial protocol confirms that the pediatric pharmacovigilance workflow is activated (true), and safety desk simulation benchmarks for suspected unexpected serious adverse reactions show a serious adverse event notification turnaround of 12 h.
SAFE-PHARMA-8WQ：For Meridian Clinical Alliance, configuration logs verify that the pediatric pharmacovigilance workflow is activated (true) within the safety database module designated for the pediatric trial protocol, while the serious adverse event notification turnaround is recorded at 48 h in safety desk simulation benchmarks.
SAFE-PHARMA-44M：For Vanguard Oncology Research Group, system configuration records confirm the pediatric pharmacovigilance workflow is activated (true) for the pediatric trial safety database module, and safety desk simulation benchmarks demonstrate a serious adverse event notification turnaround of 24 h.
